description: RHEIA combines deterministic and stochastic multi-objective optimisation with uncertainty quantification for hydrogen and derived energy-carrier systems. It includes energy-system models and allows users to connect other models. The provider is RHEIA framework developers. Coverage: The methods are generic to user-defined designs and uncertain inputs. Geographic coverage, operating periods and temporal resolution depend on the selected system model. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies MIT and a public package installation route. Input data and external dependencies retain separate terms. Limitations: The README and software paper establish the tool, but independent reuse and current maintenance were not verified. Optimised designs depend on the chosen uncertainty distributions. For simulation it supports uncertainty-aware hydrogen-system design comparisons. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly identifies this RHEIA energy-design tool.
